repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
t = (#Living_Temp).temperatureSensor_temperature
all(#Speaker).speaker_speak("The living room is " + t + " degrees")

diagnosis.summary: The candidate script translates the temperature value into Korean ('거실 온도는 ...도입니다'), whereas the IR specification requires the exact English string ('The living room is ... degrees'). F2 shows the argument mismatch at the same instant. The binding slot for Speaker allows both 'Living_Speaker' and 'Kitchen_Speaker', and the IR action targets both, matching the candidate's use of 'all(#Speaker)'. The only defect is the language of the literal string argument.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the Korean string literal with the exact English string literal required by the IR. Preserved the 'all(#Speaker)' selector and the arithmetic concatenation of the sensor value.
